commits: f80c8c8 Remove navbar on game sections (/play, /daily)
summary: No-finding pass. The scoped change is presentation-only: FreeStackShell.tsx now wraps the <Navbar> in {!gameSection && (...)} so it renders on /climb (leaderboard) but not on the /play and /daily game sections, plus one added test. Zero security surface — no auth gate removed, no data fetch, no route handler, no input handling, no secret, no env access, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no redirect, no new dependency. Per context/trust.md #5, authorization lives in route handlers (requireAuth/requireAdmin); the Navbar is marketing/account chrome, not an access-control boundary. NavbarAuth/account-state logic is untouched (Navbar.tsx is not in the diff) — it is simply not mounted on two already-public game pages. No .env file appears in the commit range. None of the product trust boundaries (client climb scores, Stripe webhooks, INTERNAL_TOKEN, SSRF, allow-list parsers) are within reach of this diff.
